systems.system: Computer equipment for the civil-status pilot communes
systems.country_label: matériel informatique remis aux communes pilotes
systems.owner: Supplied by the Ministère de l'Efficacité du service public et de la transformation digitale and handed over by the Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC) on 8 April 2026
systems.tiers: Five pilot communes: Golfe 1, Agoè-Nyivé 1, Lacs 1, Avé 2 and Zio 2; two computers, one printer, one UPS and two extension leads each

systems.system: Digitalisation of requests for copies of civil-status records
systems.country_label: projet de digitalisation des demandes de copies d'actes d'état civil
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC), with the digital transformation ministry as lead on digitalisation
systems.tiers: Pilot phase launched 19 December 2025 in the same five communes; national extension planned after evaluation

note: Equipment and an application, with no connection stated: the ministry says the five pilot communes had begun the work but lacked computers and printers to produce the copies, and were given two computers and a printer each on 8 April 2026. Nothing says how or whether the commune offices are connected, so no fact.
